controls.title: Mandatory SAML 2.0 Single Sign-On and Hardware MFA
controls.description: Enforce SAML SSO across all workspace members with phishing-resistant FIDO2 MFA.

controls.title: SCIM Automated User Lifecycle Provisioning
controls.description: Automate user provisioning and immediate deprovisioning using SCIM protocol.

controls.title: Workspace App Approval Enforcement
controls.description: Enable workspace-wide app approval mode to require administrative sign-off before app installation.

controls.title: Granular OAuth Scope Principle of Least Privilege
controls.description: Restrict custom and third-party apps to minimal granular bot/user token scopes.

controls.title: Zero Credential Logging & Secure Token Storage
controls.description: Prohibit committing or logging Slack tokens and webhook URLs; load from secure environment variables.

controls.title: HMAC-SHA256 Request Signature Verification
controls.description: Verify X-Slack-Signature using HMAC-SHA256 and enforce a 300-second timestamp freshness window.

controls.title: Audit Logs API Ingestion
controls.description: Stream Slack Audit Logs API v2 events into centralized SIEM for real-time security monitoring.

controls.title: Broadcast Mention Authorization Gate
controls.description: Require explicit human authorization before dispatching @channel, @everyone, or @here mentions.
